senses.gloss: a border between two countries or settled and unsettled land
senses.example: The town grew near the frontier between the two countries.

example_translations.zh_TW: 這座城鎮在兩國邊境附近發展起來。
example_translations.ja_JP: その町は二国間の国境近くで発展した。
example_translations.ko_KR: 그 마을은 두 나라 사이의 국경 근처에서 성장했다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Thị trấn phát triển gần biên giới giữa hai quốc gia.
example_translations.th_TH: เมืองนี้เติบโตขึ้นใกล้พรมแดนระหว่างสองประเทศ

definition_translations.ja_JP: 2つの国の間の境界、または定住地と未定住地
